questions.prompt: In the number 5,382, what is the place value of the digit 3?

choices.feedback: Count from the right: ones, tens, hundreds. The 3 sits one place further left than the tens.
The 5 is in the thousands place. The 3 is right next to it.
300 is the total value. The place value is the NAME of the place.

hints: Write the number under the labels: Th, H, T, O.
Start from the ones place on the right.
questions.explanation: 5,382 has 5 thousands, 3 hundreds, 8 tens and 2 ones. So the 3 is in the hundreds place.

questions.prompt: Which number has the digit 4 in the ten-thousands place?

choices.feedback: In 14,502 the 4 is in the thousands place.
In 25,041 the 4 is in the tens place.
In 52,104 the 4 is in the ones place.

hints: Ten-thousands is the 5th place from the right.
questions.explanation: In 45,210 the 4 is the first digit of a 5-digit number, so it is in the ten-thousands place.

questions.prompt: What is the total value of the digit 7 in 27,450?
hints: The 7 is in the thousands place. 7 thousands = ?
questions.explanation: The 7 is in the thousands place, so its total value is 7 x 1,000 = 7,000.

questions.prompt: Which shows 36,205 broken into the total values of its digits?

choices.feedback: Every part is ten times too small. The 3 is in the ten-thousands place.
The 5 is in the ones place, so it is just 5. There are 0 tens.
Check each digit: the 6 is in the thousands place and the 2 is in the hundreds place.

hints: Name the place of each digit first.

questions.prompt: A library has 4 ten-thousands, 6 thousands, 0 hundreds, 5 tens and 2 ones of books. How many books is that altogether?
hints: Write each digit in its place: 4 _ _ _ _.
There are 0 hundreds, so write 0 in the hundreds place.

questions.prompt: Write the number made of 7 ten-thousands, 0 thousands, 3 hundreds, 9 tens and 4 ones.
hints: Fill the places from the left: ten-thousands, thousands, hundreds, tens, ones.

questions.prompt: Brian says 9,876 is greater than 10,234 because 9 is bigger than 1. What is wrong with his thinking?

choices.text: 10,234 has a ten-thousands place, so it has more digits and is greater.
Nothing is wrong. Brian is correct.
choices.feedback: Compare the number of digits first. A 5-digit number is greater than a 4-digit number.

choices.text: He should have compared the last digits instead.
choices.feedback: We compare from the largest place value, not from the ones.

choices.text: He should have added the digits of each number.
choices.feedback: Adding digits does not tell us which number is greater.

hints: Count the digits in each number.
questions.explanation: 10,234 has 5 digits and 9,876 has 4 digits. A number with more digits (no leading zero) is greater.

questions.prompt: The total value of 6 in 4,365 is 60. Which number has a 6 whose total value is ten times as much?

choices.feedback: The 6 here is worth 6,000. That is 100 times 60, not 10 times.
The 6 here is worth 60 again. We need a value 10 times bigger.
The 6 here is worth 6. That is 10 times SMALLER than 60.

questions.explanation: 10 x 60 = 600. A 6 is worth 600 in the hundreds place, as in 7,613.
